title: Viva Engage: community feeds default to all posts, sorted by recent posts
summary: The briefing passes: the default, feed preferences and rollout window agree with Microsoft's notice and the roadmap record. Two minor corrections remain: describe the existing Microsoft 365 entitlement for communities, and keep the expected rollout completion date conditional.
